scripts.clean: tsc -b packages/core packages/cli --clean && rm -rf packages/core/dist packages/cli/dist
scripts.pack:dry: npm run build && npm --cache .npm-cache pack --workspace graph-engineering-loop-core --dry-run && npm --cache .npm-cache pack --workspace graph-engineering-loop --dry-run
scripts.smoke:fake: npm run build && node packages/cli/dist/cli.js run examples/fake/loops.json --adapter fake
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core packages/cli --pretty false && tsc -b packages/core packages/cli --clean
